{{Quote|That speeder is leaking ''coolant''... it'll be ''burnt out'' by morning!|Stormtrooper|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 31">[[Star Wars (1977) 31|''Star Wars'' (1977) 31]]</ref>}}
[[File:DroidCoolant.png|thumb|right|200px|Droid coolant]]
'''Coolant''' was a term for substances used for cooling things. Several different types of coolant were in use in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and several substances were used as coolant. The [[Galaxy IV Coolant Refinery]] was a defunct coolant factory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Starship weapons required coolant maintenance and monitoring, as was performed at the [[Number Two Turbolaser Coolant Room]] aboard ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. Non spin-sealed [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas was used as [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] coolant.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] used a coolant fluid to keep their internal temperatures from rising too high, which would cause them to overheat and shut down. At least one type of coolant used in droids was a [[Color/Legends|blue]] fluid that was [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] to some [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="A Bad Feeling: The Tale of EV-9D9">''[[A Bad Feeling: The Tale of EV-9D9]]''</ref>
